business_meaning: Technical identifier of one customer order
Customer account that placed the order (FK to customers)
Calendar date the order was placed
Lifecycle status of the order (normalized spelling)
Sales channel used to place the order
Country where the order is shipped
Gross order amount including VAT and shipping
Technical identifier of one payment event
Order this payment belongs to (FK to orders)
Date the payment event was recorded
Payment amount — EUROS with 2 decimals NOT cents
ISO currency code of the payment
Last 4 digits of the card when method is card; empty otherwise
